question: Who among the following became the first woman Vice Chancellor of Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU), India in February 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Santishree Dhulipudi Pandit.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian academic **Santishree Dhulipudi Pandit serves as the** university's vice chancellor** in **New Delhi.**
 
• She is the **first woman** to occupy the position.
 
• Prior to this, she was a **political science professor** at** Savitribai Phule Pune University.**
 
• On **February 7, 2022,** the Ministry of Education nominated her as **Jawaharlal Nehru University's** thirteenth vice-chancellor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Madhuri Dixit:**

 
 
• **Indian actress** Madhuri Dixit Nene primarily appears in **Hindi language films.**
 
• Since **2014,** she has collaborated with **UNICEF** to promote **children's rights and stop child labour.**
 
 
 
• **Supriya Sule:**
 
 
• Supriya Sule is a **Nationalist Congress Party** politician from India.
 
• She is now serving as **Baramati's representative **in the **17th Lok Sabha.**
 
• She began a statewide campaign against **female foeticide in 2011.**
 
 
 
• **Smriti Irani:**
 
 
• Smriti Zubin Irani is an** Indian politician** who has also worked as a **producer, model, and ac**tor.
 
• Since May **2014,** she has served as a minister in the** Indian Union Cabinet.**
 
• At the moment, she is in charge of running the **Ministries of Women and Child Development.**
 
• In addition, she is the** first non-Muslim **to hold the position of **Minister of Minority Affairs. **
